title: Para Bellum content: combat
description: The auto-resolve battle weights. File: Content/<namespace>/combat.json, exactly ONE across every namespace: the game refuses a second copy and refuses a content set with none. A mod cannot override this file (a recorded limitation; a total-conversion mod would want to, which is why override semantics is the first modding-API item after this sprint). Ratios are per mille, and every figure is a whole number. Integer inputs here buy auditability and one house unit, but the battle arithmetic itself remains floating point. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

defense_weight_per_level_per_mille.description: The defender's bonus per level of terrain defence, per mille.

river_assault_penalty_per_mille.description: The attacker's strength multiplier when assaulting into a river hex, per mille.

luck_spread_per_mille.description: The width of the random swing on each side's strength, per mille.

destroy_floor_strength.description: A unit at or below this strength is destroyed, in strength points.

late_contribution_per_mille.description: What a company committed late contributes, per mille. It costs its full points.

unpierced_attack_per_mille.description: THE THRESHOLD: what an attack is worth, per mille, against a target whose armour exceeds the attacker's piercing. It is a step, not a gradient.

recce_narrow_per_level_per_mille.description: How much of the enemy-strength band each level of committed recce removes, per mille.

refit_strength_floor.description: A COMMIT LIMIT (D103). value: a company below this strength is refitting and cannot be committed. Strength is a percentage of full, 0 to 100, so Has is the company's strength and Bound is this value, both in % strength.

reach_days.description: A COMMIT LIMIT (D103). value: how many days of travel away a formation can still join an engagement, an integer. Has is the formation's travel time in FRACTIONAL days, and is NOT FINITE (infinity) when there is no route: a reader must show that as no route, never print it as a number. Bound is this value.

engagement_budget_points.description: A COMMIT LIMIT (D103). value: each side's budget in an engagement, in the same deployment points a company costs. Has is the company's deployment_points; Bound is what is LEFT of the budget after what is already committed, not this value.

limit.description: A commit limit, with the words a player reads when it stops a commit (D103): an open set of limits is only open if what the player reads travels with the key. A reader lists the limits in this schema's order, refit_strength_floor, reach_days, engagement_budget_points, never in the file's.

name.description: What the player reads as the reason a company cannot be committed.

unit.description: What the player reads after the figures Has and Bound.
